retired_review_rows.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volume_view.angles_from_axes#1
retired_review_rows.source: ``elev`` is kept inside ``[-90, 90]`` so the vertical never flips; the roll then carries whatever turn about the line of sight the frame has. Looking straight down (or up) the azimuth is free, so it is chosen to make the roll zero.
